intake.processDescription: Synthetic website form submissions arrive as signed HTTP POST events at a confirmed endpoint and should be checked before being added to a demo lead queue.
goals: Capture form submissions without duplicate records

sources.content: Validate incoming webhook payloads and use an idempotency key before writing a CRM record.
For inbound support mail, preserve the original message ID when routing a ticket.

intake.processDescription: When the synthetic storefront emits its documented order-created webhook, validate the payload and create a review item; do not charge a payment or email anyone.
goals: Make new orders visible for a human review

sources.content: A named human reviewer must approve any sensitive or externally visible action.
Validate webhook signatures, required fields, and replay identifiers before processing events.

intake.processDescription: A synthetic document portal calls a confirmed webhook after each upload. Extract metadata and place a draft task in the local review queue.

sources.content: Use narrowly scoped credentials and minimize the fields copied between systems.
Reject webhook events with invalid signatures or missing required fields; retain an audit trail.

intake.processDescription: A test inventory service supports a documented stock-changed webhook. On each event compare the SKU and quantity with a local reference table, then flag discrepancies for review.

sources.content: Use an event trigger when the source system reliably emits the business event being monitored.
Deduplicate repeated events using a stable event identifier.

intake.processDescription: Synthetic supplier invoices arrive in a dedicated mailbox. Classify each new message, extract invoice metadata, and prepare a draft record for accounting review.

sources.content: Use a mailbox trigger for new email and retain the provider message ID to prevent duplicate intake.
Use a scheduled trigger for periodic reconciliation jobs.

intake.processDescription: Each new message to the synthetic helpdesk address should be categorized and routed to a draft ticket. An agent must review the category before a reply is sent.
goals: Speed up support triage without auto-sending replies

sources.content: Trigger on newly received messages and deduplicate by immutable message identifier.
A human must review generated replies before they are sent externally.

intake.processDescription: When a synthetic mailbox receives a message with a CSV attachment, validate its columns and create a review report; never overwrite the source file.

sources.content: Validate file type and size, preserve the original, and write transformed output to a separate location.
A new-message event is the natural trigger for mailbox intake.

intake.processDescription: Incoming delivery-failure notifications in a synthetic mailbox should be parsed and added to a monitoring queue for an operator to inspect.

sources.content: Use a new-email trigger and retain a stable message key for idempotent processing.
Retries should be bounded and only repeat idempotent operations.

intake.processDescription: At 02:00 Europe/Berlin every night, compare a synthetic CSV export with a demo PostgreSQL table and save a discrepancy report without changing either source.

sources.content: Use a scheduled trigger for recurring reconciliation and report discrepancies without mutating source data.
Webhooks are appropriate when the source emits an event immediately.

intake.processDescription: On the last calendar day of each month, collect synthetic usage totals from two demo APIs and prepare a finance review summary.

sources.content: For calendar-based jobs, specify timezone, schedule, and behavior when a run is missed.
Financial records or reports should remain drafts until a named reviewer approves publication.

intake.processDescription: Every Monday morning scan synthetic demo contracts for expiry dates within 45 days and create a report for the operations team.
goals: Warn the team before demo contracts expire

sources.content: Use recurring schedules for periodic scans; document timezone and missed-run handling.
Only copy fields necessary for the intended report.

intake.processDescription: Run a synthetic reconciliation every hour between the demo order table and a local shipment table, then flag mismatches for review.

sources.content: Periodic comparisons can run on a schedule and should be observable and idempotent.
Use a stable key when repeated events might otherwise create duplicate records.

intake.processDescription: A reviewer clicks a Start Review button after checking a synthetic vendor packet. The workflow should prepare a checklist and stop before any approval decision.

sources.content: A user-initiated review should start explicitly and preserve the human as the decision maker.
Mailbox ingestion begins when a new email arrives.

intake.processDescription: An operations specialist manually starts a dry-run from an internal form after selecting a date range; output is a preview only.
goals: Preview a reconciliation before scheduling it

sources.content: An explicit operator action is a manual trigger; do not infer a recurring schedule.
Recurring jobs use a calendar schedule and timezone.

intake.processDescription: A manager opens a pending synthetic case and presses Prepare Draft. The automation formats a proposal but must not approve or publish it.

sources.content: Keep a named human responsible for approval and any external publication.
A direct user action can start a bounded manual workflow.

intake.processDescription: An analyst selects a synthetic customer segment in a dashboard and clicks Generate Preview. The system should return a downloadable draft file for the analyst only.

sources.content: Use a manual trigger for an on-demand action initiated by a user.
Generate output separately and do not overwrite source data.

intake.processDescription: The synthetic team wants to spend less time copying information, but has not said which event or system should begin the process.

sources.content: Before designing automation, confirm the trigger, source system, data owner, and expected outcome.
Validate webhook payloads before processing a confirmed webhook event.

intake.processDescription: A synthetic lead form should update a selected CRM, but the CRM vendor, API availability, authentication method, and event delivery are not known.

sources.content: Confirm system capabilities, authentication, permissions, and ownership before proposing an integration.
Use idempotency for a supported incoming webhook.

intake.processDescription: The request says to run after every order event and also says the team will manually start the workflow once per month; the intended trigger is undecided.

sources.content: Resolve conflicting trigger requirements with the process owner before implementation.
A monthly run is represented by a recurring schedule.

intake.processDescription: Some updates arrive by email, but others may come from a portal; the requester has not confirmed which event should create a case.

sources.content: When sources conflict or are uncertain, ask which event is authoritative before choosing a trigger.
A confirmed new-message event can initiate email intake.
